539:t_002:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Looks like they planned to welcome us from the very start.」

539:t_002:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「A cracker of bullets and cannon fire - what VIP treatment!」

539:t_002:2.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Captain $$ジェフリー$$, is this all right?」

539:t_002:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Originally we meant to ask for their cooperation as a force against the $$新地球皇国$$, but in this situation that seems impossible.」

539:t_002:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, return fire. But do not take needless losses.」

539:t_003:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「I never thought I'd hear you say 'please'.」

539:t_003:3.en:
$n
「We can't very well turn that down.」

539:t_003:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「$$キリコ$$! Your Dog is a special version, rebuilt with the best parts we could gather!」

539:t_003:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Go, $$キリコ$$. We'll cut the path open.」

539:t_003:7.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I'll guard your back. Just keep your eyes forward.」

539:t_003:9.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Why!? Why is everyone trying to help a surly man like that!」

539:t_003:11.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Admit it. $$キリコ$$ is not like you.」

539:t_003:12.en:
$$カレン$$
「He doesn't talk much, but $$キリコ$$ is a good guy! Everybody knows that!」

539:t_003:13.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Not that an old boy like me should say it, but a guy who joins $$ファイヤバグ$$ of his own accord is like the moon and the naked turtle.」

539:t_003:14.en:
$$アル$$
「Isn't the correct form of that idiom 'the moon and the turtle'?」

539:t_003:17.en:
$$キリコ$$
「The entry point is over there.」

539:t_004:0.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「The target is the Cathedral, then.」

539:t_004:2.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Understood. I'll take out the enemies approaching you first.」

539:t_004:3.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「I won't let you go, $$キリコ$$! Even if it costs me my life, I'll take you down!」

539:t_005:0.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Be careful! Something is coming from near the Cathedral!」

539:t_006:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「It's the one $$テイタニア$$ was piloting!」

539:t_006:2.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「That is the $$オーデルバックラー$$... A unit granted to the 13th Rank, the 'Shield of Order'.」

539:t_006:3.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Which means whoever is piloting it is...」

539:t_006:5.en:
$$ネクスタント$$
「Martial prowess is the harmony of all things. Battle itself is peace.」

539:t_006:6.en:
$$ネクスタント$$
「All things are born of battle, and through it they are formed and transformed.」

539:t_006:7.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Already under the control of the auxiliary brain.」

539:t_006:10.en:
$$キリコ$$
「The one behind them is a god...」

539:t_006:13.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「The being that ruled $$アストラギウス$$ from the shadows. Its true nature is a collective of people with extraordinary powers who were banished from planet $$クエント$$...」

539:t_006:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So that is the god of the $$マーティアル$$...!」

539:t_006:18.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「It's been a while, $$キリコ$$. I'm sorry I couldn't even greet you during the $$赫い霍乱$$ at $$アレギウム$$.」

539:t_006:20.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「...You'll have your answer once you reach the Cathedral.」

539:t_006:21.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Fine. If $$ワイズマン#pilot$$ is going to cling to me again, I'll crush him.」

539:t_006:22.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「I expect a good fight, $$キリコ$$. The $$ネクスタント$$ guarding the Cathedral are super soldiers who surpass $$ＰＳ$$.」

539:t_006:23.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Even for you, a hard fight is unavoidable.」

539:t_006:24.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Be careful, $$キリコ$$! A $$ネクスタント$$ controlled by the auxiliary brain is a machine for slaughter, with no emotion at all!」

539:t_006:25.en:
$$キリコ$$
「...I don't intend to obey anyone.」

539:t_006:27.en:
$$キリコ$$
($$ワイズマン#pilot$$, wait for me.)

539:t_007:0.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Go, $$キリコ$$! I'll hold this place to the death!」

539:t_007:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I'm counting on you, $$テイタニア$$.」

539:t_008:0.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(He said he's counting on me... huh...)

539:t_008:1.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(With those words, I can... go on living forever...)

539:t_009:0.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「You shall not pass here!」

539:t_009:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'm coming now! Hold out until then!」

539:t_009:3.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I told $$キリコ$$ I would hold this place to the death! I'll stake my life on it!」

539:t_012:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
「$$テイタニア$$ will be here soon too.」

539:t_012:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Don't let your guard down! Something else is coming!」

539:t_013:0.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「A fleet of land battleships!」

539:t_013:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
「$$ワイズマン#pilot$$'s will dwells in those.」

539:t_013:2.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Same as on planet $$クエント$$.」

539:t_014:0.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Sorry. I was searching for a usable $$ＡＴ$$ and it made me late.」

539:t_014:2.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I moved $$フィアナ$$ somewhere safe. Don't worry.」
